purpose: Transparent source-to-predicted-assembly experiment; not a formal timing model
core_timing_assumption: Cortex-M4 core timing with no bus contention; use the listed engineering costs exactly
multi_register_rule: For PUSH, POP, LDM, or STM, dynamic_count is the number of registers transferred, not merely the number of mnemonics.
pflash_policy: Exact S32K148 PFlash/cache/prefetch configuration is not supplied. Do not invent a wait-state count. Core branch-refill costs are included above; any remaining PFlash fetch contribution stays unresolved and is not silently hidden.
sources: Arm Cortex-M4 Technical Reference Manual and instruction timing documentation
GNU ARM GCC target and optimization documentation
